calls.reasoning: Spot VIX is 14.53 (Sep 4 close, FRED), within 0.3 of the 2026 low. Reference class: 9-trading-day windows starting with VIX 13.5-15.5, where max-intraday/start has a median near 1.18-1.20 -> ~17.3. The window has only 9 sessions (Sep 7 is Labor Day) but is event-dense: ECB Sep 10, Aug CPI Sep 11, a coin-flip FOMC hike decision with dot plot Sep 16 (fed funds futures 56-66% for a hike after the 162k payrolls beat), and quad witching Sep 18. No prediction market prices this (Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi: none found), and I could not retrieve the VIX futures curve, so there is no market anchor; evidence on the tail is qualitative, which keeps me near the reference class.

calls.reconciliation: Three runs clustered at medians 17.3 / 17.4 / 18.2. Two factual disputes mattered. (a) Intraday OHLC: Run 2's Yahoo series is internally coherent (highs 1-4% above matched FRED closes; Sep 1 high 16.80 vs close 16.34), while Run 3's discarded pull showed an August high of 22.66 against a max August close of 16.50 and rows dated after Now - Run 3 was right to discard its own pull, but Run 2's differs and survives the coherence check, so I adopt the ~2-4% high-over-close premium and the 16.80 20-session max. (b) The 'soft payrolls' characterization Run 3 flagged is an aggregation error: two runs independently report 162k vs ~53-55k consensus with matching index moves. Unsettled without web access: the exact Sep 4 close (14.40 vs 14.53, immaterial at 0.9%), and the hike-odds gap (CME ~50% vs Polymarket 70-72%) - the contracts are not the same object (Polymarket bundles 50bp+), so I let it carry its uncertainty and priced it into the tail rather than the level. On judgment I side with Runs 1-2's ~1.20 ratio over Run 3's 1.23: Run 3's n=4 sample is contaminated by higher-vol July windows, whereas August 2026's own five overlapping windows delivered 1.04-1.13 close-based, and Run 1's driftless-walk anchor independently gives ~1.20. I carry Runs 1-2's reference class forward, agreeing with it. My 17.5 is not a split of the three - it is the class median on the reconciled spot, held there by the post-payrolls non-reaction, with a wider 75-90 than Run 1 because the crowding evidence is real even though unpriceable.
